lic interest requires that Herbert E.

NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the 
authority vested in me by section 204 of 
the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 404

said Herbert E. Gaston from compulsory 
retirement for age for an indefinite 
period of time not extending beyond 
June 30, 1955, the date on which his 
present term of office expires.
